    01 · Every set becomes art

    Each night draws its own cover.

    These covers are not designed. They are drawn by the music. The outer edge is the real sound wave of the set, start to finish, clockwise from the top. The rings are the same wave folded into the record. The white dot is the loudest moment of the night. The color is the year.

    1. You record the setSame as you do now. Nothing changes at the club.
    2. Drop it in one folderFrom your laptop or phone. That's the only step.
    3. It's live, labeled and wearing its own artPosted to SoundCloud as "Oscar G · Live at [club] · [city] · [date]", with a cover drawn from that night's sound, and added to the record above.
    Drop any recording (MP3, WAV) here. It never leaves this page.
    The archive

    Every night we could find.

    Sorted by club, city and date. Covers marked "real wave" are drawn from that set's actual sound. Tap one and the needle goes there.

    From Murk and Funky Green Dogs to this year. Each one is a gold mark on the record.

    02 · "I was there"

    Every night has a crowd. Now they can sign it.

    Each set gets its own page. People who were in the room tap "I was there" and add their photos and videos from that night. The set becomes a shared memory of that night.
